result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal scroll section and cut-off content at the bottom of the visible area.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side. The restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is truncated and the full card content is not visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card container width or implement proper overflow handling for the horizontal scroll to ensure all cards are fully visible or properly truncated with ellipsis. Consider adjusting padding/margins to prevent content cutoff.

issues.description: Content at the bottom of 'Popular right now' section is cut off. Restaurant information and delivery details below the pizza image are not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate spacing and padding below content sections so that all information is visible without requiring scroll. Review the scroll behavior and card dimensions to prevent content from being clipped.
